title: Maximum EMF
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum induced EMF using the formula Em = n B S ω, with the correct area S = L1 * L2.

title: Maximum Current
description: Important: Applies Ohm's law for the full circuit to find the maximum current, Im = Em / (R + r).

title: Effective Current Reading
description: Essential: Correctly converts the maximum current to the effective (RMS) value for the ammeter reading using I_eff = Im / √2.

title: Resistor Power
description: Essential: Calculates the average power dissipated in the external resistor using P = (I_eff)^2 * R.

title: Area Calculation
description: Important: Identifies and uses the correct rectangular area (L1 * L2) in the EMF formula.

title: Circuit Resistance
description: Important: Uses the total circuit resistance (R + r) in the current calculation, not just the external R.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout the calculation (e.g., meters for length, Tesla for B).

title: Peak vs. RMS Confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses the maximum current Im (or maximum EMF) directly as the ammeter reading, failing to divide by √2.

title: Ignoring Coil Resistance
description: Pitfall: Omits the internal resistance r of the coil when calculating the circuit current.
